engelen.title: Troubleshooting an Intrusion Detection Dataset: the CICIDS2017 Case Study
engelen.evidence: §III-A/B: first-FIN split, TCP appendices, ignored RST, timing/IP-only labels; §IV: reconstruction
engelen.scope: CICIDS2017; specific mechanisms, not proof of every current exact-vector collision

liu.title: Error Prevalence in NIDS datasets: A Case Study on CIC-IDS-2017 and CSE-CIC-IDS-2018
liu.evidence: Author tools and dataset documentation, corrected labels updated 2023; 2018 FTP closed-port example

rosay.title: Network Intrusion Detection: A Comprehensive Analysis of CIC-IDS2017
rosay.evidence: §3.2.2–3.2.5, especially improper session termination producing similar flows with different labels
rosay.scope: Similar does not prove exact equality over our selected features

xie.title: Analysis and Detection against Network Attacks in the Overlapping Phenomenon of Behavior Attribute
xie.evidence: Same-feature/different-label phenomenon; UNSW-NB15 and CCCS-CIC-AndMal-2020; journal October 2022, arXiv September 2023
xie.scope: Corroborating phenomenon in other datasets, not CIC2017/18 cause evidence

cantone.title: Machine Learning in Network Intrusion Detection: A Cross-Dataset Generalization Study
cantone.evidence: Within-dataset high scores versus cross-dataset degradation; CIC2017/18 and LycoS variants
cantone.scope: Motivates external validation; not a direct exact-duplicate explanation
cantone.local_pdf_note: Local PDF is February 2024 preprint; final venue/title verified against author repository final published PDF
